part: full-part2 · ACT THREE + TAG + END CREDITS (Act Four is its own timeline)

beats.caption: 2S, the home room opened close: desk, rack, monitor, cyan key, glass. Two faint marks, room for one more
cues: on the wallpaper at his right shoulder, the faded outline of a sphere with nothing in it
music: MM-01 Water Line, one continuous performance across sc 18-22

beats.caption: DELIVERY: the rack's drive slot whirs and slides a box out like a tray onto the desk
ECU: he lifts the lid. A servo whirs; a one-lens chrome sphere rises in three held steps, swivels, dilates
1-beat freeze, then THE ORB's card rides the live room
onscreen: THE ORB / IT'S SEEN THINGS. MOSTLY IRISES.

beats.caption: MCU: a cyan scan cone across his face; inside it, 5 frames of GLYPH tokens in the shape of a calm man
2S: the Orb drifts to his right shoulder and settles exactly into the faded outline. It fits. It always has
beats.vo: i didn't need to be verified.
cues: the Water Line thins to one felt note under the V.O.

beats.caption: Mas, to the Orb. Chime: a soft two-note chip chime on F (never a startup chime)
2S: the Orb's iris flicks to the monitor; its toast labels the rail's jump back
ITEM 1 · POV the tour poster with one more city pasted on; a caption slides under his face
beats.real: JUN 7–8, 2023 · "totally hopeless to compete with us" [V · trimmed]

beats.caption: In the monitor's glass his reflection sips; the Orb's reflected iris swivels from the caption to him
ITEM 2 · POV: SIRRAH at a lectern; the A and I blocks beside her are now waist-high

lines.text: "AI is kind of a fancy thing. First of all, it's two letters."

beats.caption: 2S: Mas holds up two fingers to the Orb. The Orb, which has no fingers, whirs, as if counting
ITEM 3 · POV: NEDIB unrolls a scroll across a desk: seven small pinky-prints, one per company
beats.real: JUL 21, 2023 · seven companies sign voluntary commitments [P]

beats.caption: 2S: Mas raises his pinky; the Orb rotates slightly. The rail rolls on by itself, past the Orb's arrival
ITEM 4 · POV: a room of tiled raised hands, every one the same drawing. A voice, with a plate only
2S: Mas raises his hand too, alone at his desk. The Orb, which has no hand, rises one pixel
POV: Nole's hand is the highest, and it's holding his phone. A plate egg under the hands

lines.text: "It's important for us to have a referee."

beats.caption: ITEM 5 · POV the lighthouse: Mario on one phone, finger raised, mid-warning. Egg: a ladder of hardcovers
OTS from behind the Orb: Mas, lit cyan, the lighthouse on the monitor past him
POV: his second phone rings; still warning, he answers it. A rent meter blinks on above the lighthouse. CUT
beats.real: SEP 25, 2023 · NOZAMA commits up to $4B to MISANTHROPIC [V]

beats.caption: OTS at the keyboard onto the monitor: a generic TIDDER reply box. He types, in source casing
beats.real: ~SEP 26, 2023 · the TIDDER comment, then the edit [V · casing to re-fetch]

beats.caption: 2S: the Orb's iris opens all the way. The rack's LEDs, blinking in eighths all episode, stop. One held beat
cues: the act's one quiet beat: the LED tick drops out; the fans keep turning

beats.caption: POV: he posts. A reply counter spins; the first reply is legible, held just long enough
He clicks edit; the comment rewrites itself in place, framed tight on the must-read phrase
2S: the LEDs resume, relieved. The counter keeps climbing. The Orb looks at him a beat longer than it needs to
POV: SEP rolls into OCT. Zero-read eggs: a framed lightning bolt; a small paper glowing on a desk, no text
beats.real: OCT 16, 2023 · THE MANIFESTO [V] · OCT 2023 · NELEH's paper, no text [V]

beats.caption: POV: the signing desk. NEDIB sits with his fountain pen raised
DELIVERY: the EO's scroll unrolls out of the monitor, over the desk, across the floor, past a shorter one
ECU: he sets his glass down on the scroll like a paperweight. The scroll stops
POV: NEDIB starts in, pen raised
A second NEDIB pops up behind the desk: cut paper, scissor edges, glossier, tie the wrong colour
A third pops up at the window, same scissor edges
The real NEDIB turns to look at them, pen raised. His stat updates in the screen's corner

lines.text: "When the hell did I say that?"

beats.caption: 2S, a slow push in: the Orb's iris flicks across the three NEDIBs and settles on the one with the pen
POV: the real NEDIB signs, in ink. The deepfakes clap
POV DevDay: the launch-night odometer clunks up through the stage and settles, legible. TASYA walks on
cues: egg in the bezel: an egg cracks on zAI's rafters; a small chrome creature hatches, already muzzled

beats.caption: HIGH, the desk from above: his phone lights with the suggested-replies strip. His thumb taps the first
2S: he reads his pick aloud. The Orb's toast arrives; its iris lingers on the phone
Bar 1 · POV the cold open's frame: the APEC stage, the hailstone bobbing, the ovation. We've caught up
cues: music: THE CLOCK takes over, one step a beat

beats.caption: Bar 2 · HIGH: the reminder lights his phone. The Orb's iris steps along the four circles to the black square
Bar 3 · 2S: the rail ticks past midnight. Mas looks down at the rail itself, then up. The reminder goes dark
ACT-OUT 2 · Bar 4: THE CLOCK stops dead. CUT TO BLACK. Under it, a crane truck's diesel grind pre-laps Vegas
2S, three marks in the wood now. The monitor runs sound-off: a painted CUT LINE, a smaller chip, a tall fence
beats.real: DEC 2023 · ODNOMIAR's "cut line" [H]; "small yard, high fence" (visual only) [K]
cues: music: MM-12 december, one felt line, continuous through both scenes

beats.caption: Monitor egg: a rubber duck on an ELGOOG demo desk; the caption under it adds a later truth
beats.real: DEC 6, 2023 · ELGOOG's duck demo, later shown not to be real-time [V]

beats.caption: ECU DELIVERY: the rack ejects EMIT: a stage-and-spotlight silhouette; in the corner, a tiny inset of Mas
beats.real: DEC 6, 2023 · EMIT: Mas CEO of the Year; ROLYAT Person of the Year [V]

beats.caption: MCU: he holds the cover up next to his face. The inset and the face wear the same expression
2S: the Orb's scan sweeps the cover. The silhouette passes at once; over his inset it re-sweeps, 2 beats late
MCU·PF: Mas, looking at the cover, not at the Orb
ECU the drawer: a CTRL keycap, the MACROSOFT check's pen, Terb's pin, tag up. He looks at the tag; closes it
The back wall: he pins the cover up, and beside it hangs a small frame holding the lanyard
THUD: a newspaper drops flat from above. The band lights; the room shakes 2 px (not the band); the desk hops
cues: the felt line stops on the thud; the rack and fans hold

beats.caption: HIGH: a plain serif masthead, never blackletter. The only text under it is a clerk's stamp, held to read
onscreen: COMPLAINT · THE GREY LADY v. NOPEAI & MACROSOFT · FILED DEC 27, 2023
beats.real: DEC 27, 2023 · THE GREY LADY sues NopeAI and MACROSOFT [V]

beats.caption: The lit UI band, the episode's second and last: the cursor is already parked on the glass
onscreen: UI: Look at glass of water

beats.caption: ECU the glass, composited after the shake. The water line is flat
MCU·PF, the button: Mas, unmoved. The chord with no third; under it the Q* vault's hum becomes its root. BLACK
